'''Grizzlo''', also known as '''Old Grizzy''' or '''Grizzy Two Tone''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point he was a [[musician]], but later retired.<ref name="SWG" />
